conditionDescription: Applies only when the participant cannot pay the filing fee.

draftingProhibited.reason: FW-001 is a California Judicial Council official form. It is filled, never redrafted. No substitute fee-waiver document is produced.

officialForms.name: Request to Waive Court Fees (California Judicial Council form FW-001)
officialForms.nameSourceNote: The registry states only "FW-001 is the general California fee waiver form." The form title given here is the standard designation of that form number; if it cannot be confirmed at output review, treat the title as unverified and use the bare form number.
officialForms.inventoryNote: No copy of FW-001 appears in the CA state pack officialFormInventory or resourcePacketInventory, and none is present in the Nationwide California folder listing recorded in the compiled profile source.allFolderFiles.

owningLane.scope: Official-form acquisition and approval: obtain the current FW-001 (and any companion FW-003 order, if the approved packet requires one — the registry does not name one), record a SHA-256, and route it through form approval.

blockedDependency: Lane D official-form acquisition — California Judicial Council form FW-001, Request to Waive Court Fees.

blockingSource.sourceStatement: FW-001 is the general California fee waiver form.

feePosture.statement: The source review does not state a filing fee for this route.
feePosture.consequence: No fee amount may be printed and the route may not state that filing is free. Whether this waiver unit is ever reached is unconfirmed until a fee is confirmed per supported county.

participantTreatmentWhileBlocked.instruction: The participant asks the county superior court clerk what the filing fee is and, if they cannot pay it, asks the clerk for form FW-001. LegalEase prefills no financial-eligibility field.

unresolvedForThisUnit: Whether any filing fee applies to a § 851.90 petition in each supported county (counsel flag cf-04).
Whether the approved fee-waiver packet requires a companion order form; the registry names only FW-001.
